title: The Murder on the Links
description: A complex murder mystery set in a French coastal town, involving a wealthy South American millionaire, his family, and a web of secrets, blackmail, and deception. The story unfolds through the investigations of the renowned detective Hercule Poirot and his assistant Captain Hastings.
intro_narrative: The story begins with Captain Hastings meeting a mysterious young woman on a train from Paris to Calais. Upon arriving in London, Hercule Poirot receives an urgent letter from Paul Renauld, a wealthy South American millionaire living in France, who fears for his life. Poirot and Hastings travel to Merlinville-sur-Mer, only to find Renauld murdered under mysterious circumstances. The investigation reveals a tangled web of relationships, secrets, and motives among Renauld's family and acquaintances.

Paul Renauld (Amelie Poirots).persona: A wealthy South American millionaire with a mysterious past. He is deeply concerned about a secret that threatens his life.
Paul Renauld (Amelie Poirots).secret: He is actually Victoria Cavendish, a fugitive from justice involved in a past murder case.

Eloise Renauld (Jeanne Poirots).persona: A woman of strong character and deep emotions. She is devoted to her husband and son but hides secrets about her husband's past.
Eloise Renauld (Jeanne Poirots).secret: She is aware of her husband's true identity and has been complicit in his plans to fake his death.

Jack Renauld (M Poirots).persona: A young man with a strong sense of justice and loyalty to his family. He is deeply in love with Jack Beroldy and is unaware of his father's true identity.
Jack Renauld (M Poirots).secret: He is involved in a romantic relationship with Jack Beroldy and is unaware of her true intentions.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Becomes increasingly distressed and evasive as the investigation uncovers his romantic entanglements and potential motives.

Madame Beroldy (Madame Daubreuil/Arthur).persona: A mysterious and seductive woman with a past shrouded in scandal. She is involved in blackmailing Paul Renauld and has a complicated relationship with her daughter.
Madame Beroldy (Madame Daubreuil/Arthur).secret: She is the infamous Madame Arthur, involved in a past murder case and currently blackmailing Paul Renauld.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Becomes defensive and evasive, denying any involvement in blackmail or the murder.

Jack Beroldy (Gabriel Beroldy).persona: A beautiful and enigmatic young woman with a troubled past. She is deeply in love with Jack Renauld and is unaware of her mother's true nature.
Jack Beroldy (Gabriel Beroldy).secret: She is involved in a plot to murder Paul Renauld for financial gain and to secure her future with Jack Renauld.

required_evidence: The long black hair found on the dagger handle
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Becomes increasingly anxious and attempts to manipulate others to divert suspicion.

Gabriel Daubreuil (Jove Daubreuils).persona: A striking and confident man with a mysterious past. He is deeply loyal to Paul Renauld and is aware of some of his secrets.
Gabriel Daubreuil (Jove Daubreuils).secret: He is aware of Paul Renauld's true identity and has been assisting him in his plans.

Santiago Renaulds (Dulcibella Kid).persona: A passionate and impulsive young woman with a strong sense of justice. She is deeply in love with Jack Renauld and is willing to take drastic measures to protect him.
Santiago Renaulds (Dulcibella Kid).secret: She mistakenly believes she killed Paul Renauld and is prepared to confess to protect Jack Renauld.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Becomes increasingly desperate and attempts to flee to avoid capture.

Amelie Christie (Detective from Sûreté).persona: A confident and somewhat arrogant detective with a strong belief in modern forensic methods. He is competitive with Poirot and often clashes with him.
Amelie Christie (Detective from Sûreté).abilities: Expert in forensic analysis, keen observer, and proficient in modern detective techniques.
